places.name: Cathedral of Santa Maria del Fiore (Duomo)
places.ai_summary: An iconic cathedral known for its stunning dome designed by Brunelleschi, offering panoramic views of Florence.
places.place_tip: Book tickets in advance to avoid long queues.
places.address: Piazza del Duomo, Florence, Italy

places.name: Uffizi Gallery
places.ai_summary: One of the most famous art museums in the world, housing masterpieces by Botticelli, Michelangelo, and Leonardo da Vinci.
places.place_tip: Use an audio guide to enhance your experience.
places.address: Piazzale degli Uffizi, Florence, Italy

places.name: Ponte Vecchio
places.ai_summary: A historic bridge over the Arno River, famous for its shops and picturesque views.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during sunrise or sunset.

places.place_tip: Explore the shops and enjoy the view of the Arno River.
places.address: Ponte Vecchio, Florence, Italy

attribution.author: Ingo Mehling
attribution.description: Ponte Vecchio from Ponte alle Grazie / Florence

places.name: Palazzo Vecchio
places.ai_summary: The town hall of Florence, featuring a striking tower and an array of Renaissance art.
places.place_tip: Climb the tower for a breathtaking view of Florence.
places.address: Piazza della Signoria, Florence, Italy

places.name: Piazza della Signoria
places.ai_summary: A vibrant square in front of Palazzo Vecchio, known for its statues and lively atmosphere.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the early morning or late evening.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the replica of Michelangelo's David.
places.address: Piazza della Signoria, Florence, Italy

places.name: Galleria dell’Accademia (David by Michelangelo)
places.ai_summary: Home to Michelangelo's David, this gallery is a must-visit for art lovers.
places.place_tip: Admire the original David statue and other masterpieces by Michelangelo.
places.address: Via Ricasoli, 58/60, 50122 Firenze FI, Italy

places.name: Basilica of Santa Croce
places.ai_summary: A beautiful basilica known for its frescoes and as the burial place of Michelangelo and Galileo.
places.place_tip: Look for the tombs of famous Italians like Michelangelo and Galileo.
places.address: Piazza di Santa Croce, 16, 50122 Firenze FI, Italy

attribution.description: Basilica di Santa Croce in Florence

places.name: Boboli Gardens
places.ai_summary: A historic park with beautiful gardens, sculptures, and fountains, offering a great view of the city.
places.place_tip: Wear comfortable shoes for walking.
places.address: Piazza Pitti, 1, 50125 Firenze FI, Italy

places.name: Pitti Palace
places.ai_summary: A grand palace with impressive art collections, including works by Raphael and Titian.
places.place_tip: Don't miss the Palatine Gallery and the Royal Apartments.
places.address: Piazza de' Pitti, 1, 50125 Firenze FI, Italy

places.name: Piazzale Michelangelo Viewpoint
places.ai_summary: A famous viewpoint offering a panoramic view of Florence, especially beautiful at sunset.
places.place_tip: Bring a camera for stunning photos of the city.
places.address: Piazzale Michelangelo, 50125 Firenze FI, Italy

places.name: San Lorenzo Market
places.ai_summary: A bustling market known for its leather goods, food stalls, and vibrant atmosphere.
places.cost: Free to enter, varies by purchase
places.place_tip: Try the local street food and shop for leather souvenirs.
places.address: Piazza San Lorenzo, 50123 Firenze FI, Italy

places.name: Medici Chapels
places.ai_summary: The burial place of the Medici family, featuring ornate chapels and tombs.
places.place_tip: Respect the dress code: no shorts or sleeveless tops.
places.address: Piazza di Madonna degli Aldobrandini, 50129 Firenze FI, Italy

places.name: Basilica di San Miniato al Monte
places.ai_summary: A stunning basilica located on a hill, offering one of the best views of Florence.
places.name_english: Basilica of San Miniato al Monte

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the early morning or late afternoon.

places.place_tip: Attend the Gregorian chant mass for a unique experience.
places.address: Via delle Porte Sante, 34, 50125 Firenze FI, Italy

places.name: Museo dell’Opera del Duomo
places.ai_summary: The museum houses original works of art and models related to the Florence Cathedral.
places.place_tip: Combine your visit with the Cathedral for a complete experience.
places.address: Piazza del Duomo, 9, 50122 Firenze FI, Italy

places.name: Arno River Walk
places.ai_summary: A scenic walk along the Arno River, offering beautiful views of the city and its bridges.

opening_hours.notes: Best enjoyed on foot or by bike.

places.place_tip: Start at Ponte Vecchio and stroll towards the Uffizi Gallery.
places.address: Lungarno degli Archibusieri, 50122 Firenze FI, Italy

places.name: Loggia dei Lanzi
places.ai_summary: An open-air sculpture gallery in Piazza della Signoria, featuring works by Cellini and Giambologna.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the early morning or late evening.

places.place_tip: Take time to admire the details of the sculptures.
places.address: Piazza della Signoria, 50122 Firenze FI, Italy

places.name: Santa Maria Novella Church
places.ai_summary: A stunning church known for its beautiful façade and remarkable art collection.
places.place_tip: Don't miss the frescoes by Ghirlandaio.
places.address: Piazza di Santa Maria Novella, 18, 50123 Firenze FI, Italy

places.name: Orsanmichele
places.ai_summary: A church and museum known for its stunning tabernacle and Renaissance art.
places.place_tip: Admire the tabernacle by Orcagna.
places.address: Via dei Servi, 50122 Firenze FI, Italy

places.name: Museo Galileo
places.ai_summary: A museum dedicated to Galileo Galilei, featuring scientific instruments and interactive exhibits.
places.place_tip: Explore the interactive exhibits for a hands-on experience.
places.address: Piazza dei Giudici, 1, 50122 Firenze FI, Italy

places.name: Mercato Centrale Food Market
places.ai_summary: A large indoor market offering a variety of fresh produce, meats, cheeses, and local delicacies.
places.cost: Free to enter, varies by purchase
places.place_tip: Sample local specialties at the food stalls.
places.address: Piazza del Mercato Centrale, 50123 Firenze FI, Italy
